details.color: the color of a dying ember

title: Entry in the register of the Norwegian Lutheran church
text: Halvor Moe of this parish came to me after service and stated that, in the hour before a blizzard, at the lake shore on the Vermillion River, he saw a lantern swinging across the field with no one carrying it. We heard harness jingling. The light was the color of a dying ember. The Brekke family had a run of bad luck after, as they generally do. I record it as it was told to me.
